namespace SqlSource
{
    /// <summary>
    /// What a generated method throws when a query that must return one row returns none, or more than one.  It
    /// derives from <see cref="global::System.InvalidOperationException" />, so a caller in another assembly
    /// that does not know this type catches that.
    /// </summary>
    internal sealed class UnexpectedRowCountException : global::System.InvalidOperationException
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates the exception for a query.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="queryName">The name of the query.</param>
        /// <param name="moreThanOne">
        /// <c>true</c> if the query returned more than one row, <c>false</c> if it returned none.
        /// </param>
        public UnexpectedRowCountException(string queryName, bool moreThanOne)
            : base(
                "The query '" + queryName + "' returned " + (moreThanOne ? "more than one row." : "no rows.")
            )
        {
            QueryName = queryName;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Creates the exception for a query that ran over a collection, at one of its items.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="queryName">The name of the query.</param>
        /// <param name="moreThanOne">
        /// <c>true</c> if the query returned more than one row for the item, <c>false</c> if it returned none.
        /// </param>
        /// <param name="itemIndex">The item's position in the collection, counted from 0.</param>
        public UnexpectedRowCountException(string queryName, bool moreThanOne, int itemIndex)
            : base(
                "The query '"
                    + queryName
                    + "' returned "
                    + (moreThanOne ? "more than one row" : "no rows")
                    + " for item "
                    + itemIndex.ToString(global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                    + "."
            )
        {
            QueryName = queryName;
            ItemIndex = itemIndex;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The name of the query.
        /// </summary>
        public string QueryName { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The position of the item that the query returned the wrong number of rows for, counted from 0, or
        /// <c>null</c> when the query did not run over a collection.
        /// </summary>
        public int? ItemIndex { get; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// What a generated SQL Server method throws when it was given a transaction, threw an exception of its
    /// own, and an error that the rest of its query raised then rolled the transaction back.  Its inner
    /// exception is the method's own.  It derives from <see cref="global::System.InvalidOperationException" />,
    /// so a caller in another assembly that does not know this type catches that.
    /// </summary>
    internal sealed class TransactionRolledBackException : global::System.InvalidOperationException
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates the exception for a query.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="queryName">The name of the query.</param>
        /// <param name="innerException">The exception that the method threw.</param>
        public TransactionRolledBackException(string queryName, global::System.Exception innerException)
            : base(
                "The transaction was rolled back by an error that the query '"
                    + queryName
                    + "' raised after the inner exception was thrown.",
                innerException
            )
        {
            QueryName = queryName;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The name of the query.
        /// </summary>
        public string QueryName { get; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// What a generated method that runs a query over a collection throws when the database reports an error at
    /// one of its items.  Its inner exception is the driver's own, and it passes on what
    /// <see cref="global::System.Data.Common.DbException" /> lets it, so a caller that catches that, or tests
    /// <c>IsTransient</c>, sees the same.
    /// </summary>
    internal sealed class CollectionItemException : global::System.Data.Common.DbException
    {
#if NET6_0_OR_GREATER
        private readonly string _sqlState;

        private readonly bool _isTransient;

        private readonly global::System.Data.Common.DbBatchCommand _batchCommand;
#endif

        /// <summary>
        /// Creates the exception for a query.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="queryName">The name of the query.</param>
        /// <param name="itemIndex">The item's position in the collection, counted from 0.</param>
        /// <param name="inner">The exception that the driver threw.</param>
        public CollectionItemException(
            string queryName,
            int itemIndex,
            global::System.Data.Common.DbException inner
        )
            : base(
                "The query '"
                    + queryName
                    + "' failed at item "
                    + itemIndex.ToString(global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                    + ": "
                    + inner.Message,
                inner
            )
        {
            QueryName = queryName;
            ItemIndex = itemIndex;
#if NET6_0_OR_GREATER
            _sqlState = inner.SqlState;
            _isTransient = inner.IsTransient;
            _batchCommand = inner.BatchCommand;
#endif
            HResult = inner.HResult;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The name of the query.
        /// </summary>
        public string QueryName { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The position of the item that the database reported the error at, counted from 0.
        /// </summary>
        public int ItemIndex { get; }

#if NET6_0_OR_GREATER
        /// <summary>
        /// The inner exception's <c>SqlState</c>.
        /// </summary>
        public override string SqlState => _sqlState;

        /// <summary>
        /// The inner exception's <c>IsTransient</c>.
        /// </summary>
        public override bool IsTransient => _isTransient;

        /// <summary>
        /// The inner exception's batch command.
        /// </summary>
        protected override global::System.Data.Common.DbBatchCommand DbBatchCommand => _batchCommand;
#endif
    }
}

==== File: SqlSource-RowBuffer.g.cs
// <auto-generated/>
#nullable enable

namespace SqlSource
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The rows of a query method, read into buffers from the shared array pool: one of up to 1,024 elements is
    /// rented and returned cleared, and a larger one is left to the garbage collector.
    /// </summary>
    [global::Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Embedded]
    internal struct SqlSourceRowBuffer<T>
        where T : class
    {
        private object[]? items;

        private int count;

        public void Add(T row)
        {
            if (items is null || count == items.Length)
            {
                Grow();
            }

            items![count++] = row;
        }

        public T[] ToArray()
        {
            if (items is null)
            {
                return global::System.Array.Empty<T>();
            }

            var result = new T[count];
            Rows().CopyTo(result);
            Release();
            return result;
        }

        public global::System.Collections.Generic.List<T> ToList()
        {
            if (items is null)
            {
                return new global::System.Collections.Generic.List<T>();
            }

            var result = new global::System.Collections.Generic.List<T>(count);
            global::System.Runtime.InteropServices.CollectionsMarshal.SetCount(result, count);
            Rows().CopyTo(global::System.Runtime.InteropServices.CollectionsMarshal.AsSpan(result));
            Release();
            return result;
        }

        public global::System.Collections.Immutable.ImmutableArray<T> ToImmutableArray()
        {
            if (items is null)
            {
                return global::System.Collections.Immutable.ImmutableArray<T>.Empty;
            }

            return global::System.Runtime.InteropServices.ImmutableCollectionsMarshal.AsImmutableArray(ToArray());
        }

        private global::System.ReadOnlySpan<T> Rows() =>
            global::System.Runtime.InteropServices.MemoryMarshal.CreateReadOnlySpan(
                ref global::System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe.As<object, T>(
                    ref global::System.Runtime.InteropServices.MemoryMarshal.GetArrayDataReference(items!)),
                count);

        private void Release()
        {
            Return(items!);
            items = null;
            count = 0;
        }

        private void Grow()
        {
            var length = items is null ? 16 : items.Length * 2;
            var next = length <= 1024 ? global::System.Buffers.ArrayPool<object>.Shared.Rent(length) : new object[length];
            if (items is not null)
            {
                global::System.Array.Copy(items, next, count);
                Return(items);
            }

            items = next;
        }

        private void Return(object[] buffer)
        {
            if (buffer.Length <= 1024)
            {
                global::System.Array.Clear(buffer, 0, count);
                global::System.Buffers.ArrayPool<object>.Shared.Return(buffer);
            }
        }
    }
}

namespace SqlSource
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Marks a static method of one argument as a conversion from its argument's type to its return type, which
    /// the generated query methods call to read a column into a property of the return type or to bind a
    /// parameter of that type from the argument's.  It is not conditional, unlike
    /// <see cref="SqlSourceGenerateAttribute" />: a project that references a library finds the library's
    /// converters in its metadata, so the attribute has to stay there.
    /// </summary>
    [global::Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Embedded]
    [global::System.AttributeUsage(global::System.AttributeTargets.Method)]
    internal sealed class SqlSourceConverterAttribute : global::System.Attribute
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Marks the member, or the primary-constructor parameter, that gives a repository its connection: a
    /// connection string, a <c>DbDataSource</c>, a <c>DbConnection</c> that the repository borrows, or a method
    /// that returns a new <c>DbConnection</c>, or a task of one, and takes nothing or a
    /// <c>CancellationToken</c>.  It is not conditional, unlike <see cref="SqlSourceGenerateAttribute" />: a
    /// repository finds a marked member of a base class in a referenced assembly in its metadata.
    /// </summary>
    [global::Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Embedded]
    [global::System.AttributeUsage(
        global::System.AttributeTargets.Field
            | global::System.AttributeTargets.Property
            | global::System.AttributeTargets.Method
            | global::System.AttributeTargets.Parameter,
        AllowMultiple = false,
        Inherited = false
    )]
    internal sealed class SqlSourceConnectionAttribute : global::System.Attribute
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// The database whose queries use the connection, as the <c>database</c> setting names it.  Needed
        /// only when the repository's queries use more than one database.
        /// </summary>
        public string Database { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Generates code for each query in the <c>.sql</c> files of the type.
    /// </summary>
    [global::Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Embedded]
    [global::System.AttributeUsage(
        global::System.AttributeTargets.Class | global::System.AttributeTargets.Struct,
        AllowMultiple = false,
        Inherited = false
    )]
    [global::System.Diagnostics.Conditional("SQLSOURCE_ATTRIBUTES")]
    internal sealed class SqlSourceGenerateAttribute : global::System.Attribute
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// A folder or one <c>.sql</c> file, relative to the folder of the file that carries the attribute:
        /// <c>"."</c> is every <c>.sql</c> file of that folder.  The default is the file named for the type in
        /// that folder, <c>UserRepository.sql</c> for <c>UserRepository</c>.
        /// </summary>
        public string Source { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Whether a repository gets its interface, which overrides the project's
        /// <c>SqlSourceRepositoryInterfaces</c> when it is written.
        /// </summary>
        public bool GenerateInterface { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The name of a repository's interface.  The default is the type's name after an <c>I</c>,
        /// <c>IUserRepository</c> for <c>UserRepository</c>.
        /// </summary>
        public string InterfaceName { get; set; }
    }
